title: NoRunningInTheHalls
description: A Minecraft mod that adds "No Running" into minecraft. You just cant sprint in Minecraft anymore...  so good luck :)
body: This Mod is a challenge... if you sprint, u will die. Dont sprint or else you loose all of your stuff! Everytime you sprint you explode. This Mod is supposed to be a challenge for survival Minecraft. WARNING, this mod is hard, so make sure to be very knowledge with Minecraft
